clips.title: The story
paras: On a ridge above Whelgar's Excavation Site, Merrin Rockweaver waits with the survivors. A raptor infestation drove them from the dig, where she represented the Explorers' League.

Merrin Rockweaver came to the Wetlands for the Ironforge Explorers' League, seeking ancient Titan secrets beneath the muck. The expedition fell apart when the large bones the crew unearthed drew raptors to the dig. The beasts swarmed the trenches, and Merrin and the surviving crew fled, leaving their equipment, notes, and progress behind. Now Merrin is trapped with a few survivors on a bluff overlooking the overrun ruins.

The survivors on the bluff still hope to save what they can of the expedition. Ormer Ironbraid plans vengeance against the beasts, while Prospector Whelgar seeks tablet fragments in the raptor-infested trenches. Merrin worries about her husband Tarrel, who has heard nothing from her in weeks. A scout Longbraid sent to find the team can carry word of their plight back to him.
